title: polybotrya cervina
intro: Polybotrya cervina, commonly known as the Cervine Bird's Nest Fern, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. It is traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, which provide several health benefits, including the treatment of fever, diarrhea, and respiratory infections. The plant's therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties, which help to soothe and protect the body from various health issues. The bioactive constituents of Polybotrya cervina include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
